record.question: How much amount was allocated for Swachh Bharat Abhiyan by Union Budget 2016-2017
record.explanation: Answer C: Rs 9000 crore. The 2016–17 Union Budget speech provided Rs 9,000 crore for Swachh Bharat Abhiyan. The original speech states this explicitly in paragraph 42. Historical/source note: Budget allocation stated in the 2016–17 speech, not actual eventual expenditure or every component's combined spending. Reference: https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/20117/6474926/Budget_Speech_2016.pdf/311c2e7e-081a-b46a-564c-d054f43d1238?t=1762782547316. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
